name: Prospector Stormpike
summary: In Ironforge, Prospector Stormpike oversees support for distant archaeological digs. A blunt, short-tempered dwarf of the renowned Stormpike clan, he also uses his sharp mind to decipher coded messages.

sections.title: Scholar of the Hall of Explorers
sections.body: Prospector Stormpike coordinates excavations from the Library of the Hall of Explorers. His work sends supplies, including blasting powder, to distant sites across Khaz Modan and beyond. He is impatient with idle chatter, but his dedication to uncovering dwarven history runs deep. His keen mind can break intricate ciphers, making him a useful ally to scouts facing secret threats.

faq.answer: Prospector Stormpike is an archaeologist and logistics coordinator of the renowned Stormpike clan. He works in the Library of Ironforge's Hall of Explorers.

faq.q: Where can I find Prospector Stormpike?
faq.answer: You can find Prospector Stormpike inside the Library, in the eastern reaches of Ironforge's Hall of Explorers.

faq.q: What kind of work does he do?
faq.answer: Stormpike manages supplies and reports for archaeological digs. He sends blasting powder to field prospectors such as Prospector Ironband in Loch Modan, and helps scouts break complex coded messages.

faq.q: Why does Southshore need his help?
faq.answer: Southshore's Alliance authorities need Stormpike to decipher intercepted letters written by the secretive Argus Wake cult.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you can see the Explorers' League spirit in Stormpike's driven, no-nonsense approach. He treats ancient research and logistics as matters of dwarven pride.
As an Alliance member, you can rely on Stormpike's skill with ciphers in operations against secretive human cults such as the Argus Wake in northern lands.
